mandatory_legal_checks: Civil Procedure Code 1908 Order XIX Rule 3 — confined to facts within the deponent's own knowledge, except on an interlocutory application where belief may be stated WITH THE GROUNDS
Civil Procedure Code 1908 Order VI Rule 15 — the verification must distinguish knowledge from information and belief
Stamp value and the officer before whom an affidavit may be sworn are STATE subjects and vary — confirm both for the State of swearing
Notaries Act 1952 S.8 — a notary may administer the oath
False evidence on affidavit is an offence under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita 2023 — the deponent should be told so before swearing
